propositions: Six rollout-created Jira comments (IDs 997143, 997144, 997145, 997255, 997256, 997293) are duplicates of six preexisting survivor comments on three tickets, creating retained payload and requiring selective deletion and Git rewrite.

The preparation phase must build an immutable manifest validating exact two-live-copy state and produce GET-only dry-run Jira cleanup and local Git history rewrite tools without mutating any external systems.

A coordinated quiet-window runbook must disable reconcile-bridge.yml, delete the exact six manifest-enumerated Jira comments in canary order, rewrite local Git history to remove corresponding comment events and snapshots while preserving six survivors, and re-enable the workflow only after verification.

Whole-store replay and parity checks must prove that the Git rewrite removes only authorized COMMENT material and snapshot deltas while preserving all six survivor events, unrelated paths, authorship, topology, refs, and fsck correctness.

Independent bundle backup/restore and epoch refusal must establish rollback capability; the preparation package must not mutate Jira, pause writers, publish leases, or update authoritative tickets history.
